Le quatorze octobre, Microsoft a officia: On October 14, Microsoft officially announced the neutralization of these three rogue platforms, involved in scam campaigns generating tens of millions of dollars. More than 750 million of these malicious messages specifically targeted Microsoft customers. The attacks affected individuals, banks, hospitals, and various businesses worldwide. The criminal operations relied on fake messages concerning blocked packages, unpaid tolls, suspended bank accounts, or overdue taxes.
L'enquête a débuté à la fin de l'année d: The investigation began late last year when the Japanese National Police alerted Microsoft about a wave of fraudulent messages in Japan. Microsoft conducted its investigations with the support of Japanese authorities, as well as several cybersecurity companies including Resecurity, Cloudflare, Oracle, Proofpoint, and TRM Labs. The operation culminated on October 14 after Microsoft obtained a U.S. court order to seize all domain names behind the three platforms.
Au cœur de cet écosystème, YAM Store fon: At the heart of this ecosystem, YAM Store operated like a standard online shop allowing users to buy fraudulent Microsoft and Google accounts, credential-stealing tools, and turnkey phishing sites. Cybercriminals bought domain names abandoned by legitimate organizations, such as charities or schools, to make them appear still active and claim Microsoft 365 accounts. The other two services, CoGUI and Iron Man, provided pre-designed messages and sites mimicking banks, government agencies, brands, or hospitals. Iron Man offered more than 2,300 templates for trap pages and messages. The tools from these platforms were resold in exchange for cryptocurrencies, notably USDT and Ether.
Démantèlement de YAM Store, CoGUI et Iro: Dismantling of YAM Store, CoGUI, and Iron Man, three services of a Chinese cybercriminal market.
Plus d'un milliard de messages frauduleu: More than one billion fraudulent messages sent since January targeting over 150 countries.
Plus de soixante-quinze mille organisati: More than 75,000 organizations targeted worldwide, with over 750 million messages targeting Microsoft customers.
Utilisation de cryptomonnaies telles que: Use of cryptocurrencies such as USDT and Ether for the resale of criminal tools.
